## architecture


# Architecture

## Components
- **App** (SwiftPM executable `AgentsMissionControl`, bundle `co.tomac.amc`, accessory app: no menu bar item, no window). `main.swift` starts `Privileged` and handles the grant step. evidence: Package.swift, Sources/AgentsMissionControl/main.swift
- **Privileged.swift**: Unix socket server, peer check, Touch ID approval, leases, runs, trace. evidence: Sources/AgentsMissionControl/Privileged.swift
- **Claude Code plugin** `mod/` (name `amc`): tool `privileged_bash`, side pane, status lines, embedded socket client; marketplace file `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. evidence: mod/
- **Installer**: `install.sh` hands a terminal to `tools/installer.py` (animated steps, signature card, guided Full Disk Access); `uninstall.sh`; `channel.sh` names an install (`AMC_CHANNEL=test` is a separate copy). evidence: install.sh, tools/installer.py, channel.sh
- **LaunchAgent** `launchd/co.tomac.amc.app.plist` (templated) opens the app at login. evidence: install.sh

## Data flow
- Plugin or `bin/amc-call` → `~/.amc/amc.sock` → app. Ops: open, run, end, status, grant (one JSON line each way).
- Trust: caller must descend from Anthropic-signed Claude Code (dynamic code-signature check on the live pid); a lease belongs to that claude pid and opens only after Touch ID or the login password; scopes `once` and `session`.
- Commands run as the app's children (`/bin/zsh -o pipefail -c`), inheriting its Full Disk Access; output to `~/.amc/runs/<id>.log`; every request hash-chained into `~/.amc/trace.jsonl`.

## State on disk
- `~/.amc/` (0700): `amc.sock`, `trace.jsonl`, `runs/`; the folder comes from Info.plist `AMCHome` (per channel). evidence: build.sh, channel.sh

## Related
- Agent Board (tomacco/agent-board) owns hands off; this repo only reads its flag `~/.agent-board/hands-off` before playing a sound. evidence: tools/installer.py#hands_off

## conventions


# Conventions

## Commits
- Imperative subject, often prefixed with the area and a colon; body explains why. evidence: git log

## Languages
- Swift 5.10 tools, macOS 26+, AppKit; no Xcode project. evidence: Package.swift
- Shell scripts are **zsh**, never bash. evidence: install.sh, tests/*.sh
- Installer UI is Python 3 standard library only (`/usr/bin/python3 -I`). evidence: tools/installer.py
- Plugin is TypeScript/TSX against the `claude-code` hooks API; JSX via `h`. evidence: mod/hooks/register.tsx

## Style
- Comments explain why, one or two lines above the code. evidence: Sources/*.swift
- Terminal art draws each pixel as two columns of background color (half-block glyphs leave seams in Terminal.app). evidence: tools/installer.py#lock_rows
- Product text names the author: Ivan Gonzalez (tomacco) · tomac.co. evidence: tools/installer.py, README.md

## workflows


# Workflows

## Build and install
- `./build.sh` → `build/AgentsMissionControl.app`, signed with the first Developer ID identity, ad hoc otherwise. evidence: build.sh
- `./install.sh` (idempotent; animated in a terminal, plain with `AMC_PLAIN=1`; `AMC_NO_GRANT=1` skips the Full Disk Access step). evidence: install.sh
- [IMPORTANT] install.sh does not restart a running app: quit it, then `open -a ~/Applications/AgentsMissionControl.app`. evidence: install.sh
- A separate test copy: `AMC_CHANNEL=test ./install.sh` and `AMC_CHANNEL=test ./uninstall.sh --yes`. evidence: channel.sh

## Test
- `zsh tests/test-privileged.sh` (needs no person) and `--touch-id` (two Touch ID prompts), from a Claude Code session. evidence: tests/test-privileged.sh
- `zsh tests/test-grant-order.sh` (opens real windows with a test copy). `zsh tests/try-install.sh` (whole install as a new user, then removed). evidence: tests/

## Plugin
- `claude plugin validate mod` and `claude plugin validate .`; run a session with it: `claude --plugin-dir mod`. evidence: mod/

## Release
- Bump `CFBundleShortVersionString` in build.sh and `version` in mod/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, add a CHANGELOG.md entry, tag `vX.Y.Z`, GitHub release. evidence: CHANGELOG.md

## Knowledge freshness
- `bash scripts/check-freshness.sh` (pre-commit and CI); after editing `.distill/`, run `bash scripts/render-adapters.sh`. evidence: scripts/

## gotchas


# Gotchas

- [IMPORTANT] Never let approval live only in the plugin: agents reach `~/.amc/amc.sock` directly (seen in a 2026-10-15 test, the agent opened its own lease). Approval is Touch ID in the app. evidence: Privileged.swift#personApproves, backlog decision-3
- [IMPORTANT] No menu bar item: some companies block running unknown apps but not a Claude Code plugin, so the UI lives in the plugin and installer. evidence: AGENTS.md
- Running the tests with `bash` fails: they are zsh. evidence: tests/*.sh shebang
- An ad-hoc signed build gets a new code identity each build, so macOS drops its Full Disk Access grant. Keep Developer ID signing. evidence: build.sh
- Full Disk Access cannot be granted by script; the app is not listed until added with + in System Settings. Granting it makes macOS relaunch the app, which drops every lease (the plugin asks for Touch ID again). The app checks its own access by opening `/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db`. evidence: Privileged.swift#hasFullDiskAccess
- Installed mid-session, a plugin misses `session.start`; this one also sets up on the first prompt. evidence: mod/hooks/register.tsx#setUp
- Plugin hooks module: a helper that receives `$` must be a top-level function, or `claude plugin validate` refuses the module; tool matchers accept only this build's tool names (use a RegExp for several). evidence: mod/hooks/register.tsx
- A command in a Bash call whose text contains `pkill` or `quit app` (even inside a heredoc) trips the session's app-quit guard. Write such scripts with the file editor. evidence: 2026-10-15 split

## glossary


# Glossary

- **Privileged session**: a Claude Code session whose approved commands run inside the app with its Full Disk Access. evidence: README.md
- **Lease**: an approval for a session, scope `once` or `session`. evidence: Privileged.swift#Lease
- **Approval**: Touch ID or the login password, asked by the app before a lease opens. evidence: Privileged.swift#personApproves
- **Trace**: `~/.amc/trace.jsonl`, the hash-chained log of every request. evidence: Privileged.swift#trace
- **Channel**: a named install (`AMC_CHANNEL`); `test` is a separate copy with its own identity and grant. evidence: channel.sh
- **Mod**: Claude Code's name for a plugin built from a hooks module; here `mod/`, plugin name `amc`. evidence: mod/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
